artworks.title: Tomb of Scipios
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and green wash
artworks.description: The image captures a scene of classical architecture and figures interacting within it. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, showing the architectural features and figures in detail. The color palette is muted, with shades of brown and beige dominating the scene. Closest to us, a man leans on a stone structure adorned with carvings, while other figures are seen conversing near an archway further back. In the distance, another individual stands near a balustrade.

artworks.title: A Roman Triumph
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown and gray wash
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of a bustling scene set in an ancient Roman setting. The drawing features numerous characters in classical robes and armor, with a large amphitheater in the center resembling the Colosseum. The foreground includes figures engaged in various activities, and the background showcases classical architectural structures and a grand ceremonial entrance. The composition is intricately detailed with fine lines and a sepia tone, depicting a dynamic tableau of historical or mythical narrative.

artworks.title: Fortitude
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a human figure standing in a relaxed pose with one foot slightly forward. The figure's head is turned slightly to the side, displaying classical facial features with distinct outlines and hair styled to resemble radiating sun rays. The person is wearing flowing robes, a draped mantle, an elaborate breastplate, and is holding a lion's skin over one arm. The background features an architectural setting with a semi-circular niche flanked by two columns, intricately detailed with carvings. The image is monochromatic with fine lines and shading for depth.

artworks.title: Study of an Elderly Woman for "Disobedience Discovered"
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash and white heightening on blue-green prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman in profile sitting on a chair. She has her arm resting on a table in front of her. Her features include a defined nose, a slightly prominent chin, and a small mouth. She wears a cap or bonnet, and a layered garment that covers her from shoulders to feet. The background has faint outlines suggesting furniture or cloth.

artworks.title: Standing Nude Binding Her Hair
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a woman in profile view. She is kneeling with one leg forward and her body slightly turned to the side. Her face is in profile, with long hair being tied up. The sketch outlines her facial features, including a nose and a closed eye looking downward. The woman appears unclothed, with draped fabrics providing some covering around her legs. The background is minimalistic, suggesting a sandy or rocky surface, with wispy lines indicating textured elements around her, possibly stones or a blanket.

artworks.title: Standing Nude with Crossed Arms
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a pose with their head tilted downward and to the side. The individual has long flowing hair and their hands are clasped in front of their body. The background features a beach with waves and either clouds or distant hills. The composition is enclosed within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Two Girls under a Cloak
artworks.medium: black chalk with pink wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a light sketch of two figures from head to mid-thighs standing together, facing forward, with one arm each raised upward as if holding or draping a light piece of fabric. The sketch depicts their faces with minimal detail, soft facial features, loose hair, and understated clothing. The background is mostly empty with faint sketch lines, and there are vague outlines of small animal-like shapes resembling dogs on either side of the figures.

artworks.title: An Old Water Mill
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black ink with gray and brown wash and blue and green chalk over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic watermill depicted with delicate ink lines and light washes of color. The architecture is the main focus, with sloping rooflines leading upward towards the top right of the image. A slightly elevated perspective provides a view inside the mill's structure. Soft browns, beiges, and hints of blue create a subdued color palette. The brushstrokes have a sketch-like quality, detailing the stone walls and wooden beams. Faint outlines of trees in the distance add depth to the drawing. Overall, the image depicts a detailed portrayal of the historical mill structure.

artworks.title: Gentleman with a Riding Crop
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing in historical attire. The individual is slightly turned to the side, looking forward. They are dressed in a long coat, knee-length breeches, stockings, and shoes with a buckle. The person holds a thin, long cane in both hands. The facial features are detailed, including a prominent nose and lips, with curly hair flowing from under a tricorn hat. The background is plain and textured, with the person casting a shadow on the ground.

artworks.title: The Cannon
artworks.description: The image presents an elevated perspective of a landscape with buildings and a spire in the distance. Figures are gathered around a cannon, with barrels and cannonballs nearby. One figure is kneeling. The artwork features intricate etching lines creating texture and movement in the clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black and white.

artworks.title: Baggage Train
artworks.description: The image shows a line of horses pulling a cart filled with large sacks and two figures seated on top. The horizon is positioned low, with the sky taking up most of the upper part. In the distance, there are suggestions of trees and figures. The etching style is detailed, especially in the horses and carts, with varying line thickness to show depth and texture. The black and white palette creates a high-contrast look. In the foreground, there is a dark shape, possibly another horse. The scene conveys dynamism with the movement of the horses and the loaded cart.

artworks.title: Officer Giving Orders to a Sentinel
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated point. The horizon line is positioned just above the center, with rolling hills stretching across the scene. Small figures and structures are visible on the horizon, suggesting a distant town or encampment. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes typical of an etching, contributing to the detailed rendering of the scene. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of sepia-toned or black inks. Two individuals stand near a large cannon, with various figures and equipment scattered in the distance. A plume of smoke rises to the right. The landscape adds depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Soldier Playing a Drum
artworks.description: The image depicts a settlement in an open landscape, with a line of trees and a small village on the horizon. Two cannons, a road, a thatched-roof dwelling with smoke, people engaged in different activities, and two figures on a barrier are also visible. The etching has fine linear strokes, providing texture and depth, and is rendered in a monochromatic color palette with rich contrasts between the lines and the background.

artworks.title: Soldier in Armor and a Cannon
artworks.description: The image displays an etching of a scene set in a landscape. In the foreground, a figure in armor stands by a cannon with cannonballs nearby. Another group is seen loading a cannon, while additional individuals go about tasks in the terrain. A windmill stands in the distance. The etching features fine lines for detail, shading for depth, and a monochrome palette for contrast.

artworks.title: Firing the Cannons
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of an artillery setup with cannons and soldiers. In the background, there is a town with church towers. The etching style depicts swirling lines for smoke. The color scheme is black ink on paper. Figures near the cannons engage in tasks with baskets and barrels around them.

artworks.title: The Flutist
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view created through detailed etching techniques. The scene includes a large, textured tree on the left side, a stone structure in the background, rolling hills, a high horizon, cloud-filled skies, distant mountains, and various structures obscured by trees and hills. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing intricate cross-hatching and line work for depth and detail.

artworks.title: The Withered Tree
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, vegetation, a town with small structures, a mountain in the distance, and a sky with clouds. The artwork is an etching with detailed line work and shading in black and white colors. Twisted branches and foliage are depicted in swirling shapes, and stylized clouds are present in the sky.

artworks.title: Two Men in Conversation
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, where distant mountains meet the sky, and there are small buildings resembling a village or town. The intricate detailing is visible in the trees, foliage, and architecture, adding texture and depth. Two figures are near us, surrounded by trees and shrubs. Further back, the terrain features rolling hills with trees, leading to buildings and mountains. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and grey to accentuate the linework and shading for contrast and dimension.

artworks.title: Houses Beside a Mountain
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with a figure walking through it. A river meanders through the scene, surrounded by trees. In the background, there are hills or low mountains. The image is created using detailed etching lines in monochromatic shades of black and white. Two large trees frame the composition.

artworks.title: Double Arched Bridge
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a riverbank. Two figures are by the water, accompanied by rocks, trees, and foliage. A stone bridge spans the river with arches. Mountains provide a backdrop, and buildings are visible in the distance. The sky is cloudy, rendered in varying shades of gray. Texture and depth are created through the use of lines.

artworks.title: A Waterfall
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed landscape with a prominent tree in the foreground. In the background, there is a village nestled among hills and mountains with a waterfall. The artwork uses fine etching strokes, monochromatic tones, and intricate details to create a classic and timeless visual effect.

artworks.title: The Stream
artworks.description: The image features a wide landscape scene with detailed trees on the left and right sides. The horizon line is high, revealing a broad view of the landscape with a distant mountain peak on the left. Towards the right, a village or city with some buildings and a bridge can be seen. The etched lines create intricate details for trees, foliage, and terrain. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing natural tones and textures. Various people and landscape elements are visible, with a person near a body of water in the foreground.

artworks.title: Mars's Revenge on Adonis
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is in the upper third, separating the land from the sky. Distant mountains and small village buildings are visible on the horizon. The sky shows clouds and a dynamic figure holding a spear. The artwork features detailed brushwork or etching, particularly in the texture of trees and clouds. The color scheme is monochrome in light and dark grays. In the foreground, a figure interacts with a wild boar, surrounded by trees on both sides.

artworks.title: Apollo and a Nymph Leading a Lion
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white engraving. The foreground features foliage and trees, while the background shows hills with a village. In the sky, there is a figure with a radiating head, depicted reclining on a cloud. The engraving is detailed and intricate, with precise lines and a monochromatic color palette of black and white.
